It exports MorphCommit, MORPH_LOG_FORMAT (the exact string of section 2.2) and readMorphLog(root, env) in this order: the rev-parse check first, one git log, the records split as point 3 says (the paths without their one leading newline), the run carried from the run commits above each card commit and ended by any other commit, keys in the interface's order. Write no test file: a probe tests you and a judge writes the example tests.

## Function Read Morph Log

The Morph-Card commits of HEAD's history, newest first, each with its card, model, run and paths, from one git log.

Behaviour: readMorphLog(root, env) → Morph Commit[]. Run Git `rev-parse --verify -q HEAD`: exit 1 (no commit yet) → []. Else gitOk `log -z --name-only --no-renames --format=<MORPH_LOG_FORMAT>` (exported: "%x1e%H%x1f" then for Morph-Card, Morph-Model, Morph-Run each "%(trailers:key=<key>,valueonly,separator=%x1d)%x1f"), so a failure (not a repository) is git's thrown Error. The output split on "\x1e", the piece before the first dropped; per record, the text before its last "\x1f" split on "\x1f" gives sha, card, model, run (each value the part before its first "\x1d", trimmed; "" when absent), the text after it split on "\0" gives the paths (one leading "\n" removed, empty pieces dropped; git's order, a rename as its two paths). The run of a card commit comes from the run commits above it: walking the records in order with current = null, a record with a card → {sha, card, model, run: current, paths} (current unchanged); else one with a run sets current to it; else (any other commit) current = null. A run's cards sit between its archive commit and the commit before the run, so a card with no archive (a debt paid by an agent) reads null.

Steps:
- calls: Run Git
- produces: Morph Commit

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given a tmpRepo (first commit "init"), then five commits, oldest first, each `commit -q -m <subject> -m <trailers>`: z writes src/z.ts, trailers "Morph-Card: z\nMorph-Model: m/w"; a data commit writes docs/n.md, no trailer; a writes src/a.ts, "Morph-Card: a\nMorph-Model: m/x\nMorph-Variant: a.v2\nMorph-Acceptance-Exit: 0"; an empty commit (--allow-empty) "Morph-Run: 20261109-120000\nMorph-Cards: 1"; a-judge rewrites src/a.ts and writes tests/a.test.ts, "Morph-Card: a-judge\nMorph-Model: m/y"; env {PATH}; when readMorphLog; then [{sha: HEAD, card "a-judge", model "m/y", run null, paths ["src/a.ts", "tests/a.test.ts"]}, {sha: HEAD~2, card "a", model "m/x", run "20261109-120000", paths ["src/a.ts"]}, {sha: HEAD~4, card "z", model "m/w", run null, paths ["src/z.ts"]}] — the data commit ends the run above it
2. given a tmpRepo, then oldest first: an empty commit "Morph-Run: 20261110-080000-89abcdef" (the mrph "deck as submitted"); b writes "lib/b one.ts", "Morph-Card: b\nMorph-Model: glm53"; c renames it (git mv) to lib/c.ts, trailer "Morph-Card: c" alone; an empty commit "Morph-Run: 20261110-080000-89abcdef"; when readMorphLog; then [{card "c", model "", run "20261110-080000-89abcdef", paths ["lib/b one.ts", "lib/c.ts"]}, {card "b", model "glm53", run "20261110-080000-89abcdef", paths ["lib/b one.ts"]}] with their shas
3. given a tmpRoot after `git init -q` (no commit); then a tmpRoot that is no repository; when readMorphLog; then []; then a thrown Error whose message begins "git log failed (exit 128): "

Data Morph Commit: One Morph-Card commit as Read Morph Log returns it.
Schema:
{ sha: string, card: string, model: string, run: string | null, paths: string[] }

## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit.
- One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr.
- Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b). primer reads files and spawns git (git's gitOk, the environment a parameter) only in Primer Command, the clock only there through deps.now; Read Runs, Read Story and Render Primer are pure functions of what they are given, no network anywhere (P12a).
- Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~.

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.
- Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread.

## Function Read Ownership

The Morph log folded per path, most recently written first, with the commits counted by model.

Behaviour: readOwnership(commits {card, model, run, paths}[], newest first) → Ownership {commits: the count, models: [{model, commits}] in order of first appearance ("" kept), paths: [{path, writes: [{card, model, run}]}]}: walking the commits in order and each commit's paths in the order given (a path repeated in one commit counted once), a path seen first is appended, and every commit naming it appends one write, so the paths run from the most recently written and each path's writes from the newest. Pure; keys in this order.

Steps:
- reads: Morph Commit
- produces: Ownership

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given [{card "p-judge", model "acme/q", run null, paths ["tests/p.test.ts", "src/p.ts"]}, {card "p", model "acme/r", run "20261109-120000", paths ["src/p.ts"]}, {card "o", model "acme/q", run "20261109-120000", paths ["src/o.ts", "src/p.ts"]}]; when readOwnership; then {commits: 3, models: [{model "acme/q", commits 2}, {model "acme/r", commits 1}], paths: [{path "tests/p.test.ts", writes [p-judge]}, {path "src/p.ts", writes [p-judge, p, o]}, {path "src/o.ts", writes [o]}]}, each write {card, model, run} of its commit
2. given []; then [{card "x", model "", run null, paths ["d/x", "d/x"]}, {card "y", model "", run "r", paths []}]; when readOwnership; then {commits: 0, models: [], paths: []}; then {commits: 2, models: [{model: "", commits: 2}], paths: [{path: "d/x", writes: [{card: "x", model: "", run: null}]}]}

Data Morph Commit: One Morph-Card commit as Read Morph Log returns it.
Schema:
{ sha: string, card: string, model: string, run: string | null, paths: string[] }

Data Ownership: What Read Ownership returns.
Schema:
{ commits: number, models: { model: string, commits: number }[], paths: { path: string, writes: { card: string, model: string, run: string | null }[] }[] }

## Function Render Primer

The markdown a fresh session reads, its sections and line formats fixed; one cut at the cap.

Behaviour: renderPrimer(digest {name, generatedAt, files, tests {language, files, tests}, runs {skipped, totals}, story: Story}, cap) → string, lines joined "\n", ending "\n". "# Primer: <name>", ""; "generated <generatedAt> · <files> files in the tree · no model call, no network"; when story.missing: "missing: " + their paths ", "-joined (measure docs/MEASURE.md, plan docs/PLAN.md, autonomy docs/AUTONOMY.md, decisions docs/DECISIONS.md). "", "## Tests", "", "- <tests> tests in <files> test files by the <language> profile (counted from text, not a run)". "", "## Runs", "": runs 0 → "- archived runs: 0"; else "- archived runs: <runs> (V2 <v2.runs>, mrph <mrph.runs>), <from> → <to>", "- cards: <written> written of <cards> (<failed> failed, <skipped> skipped); requests <requests>, answers kept <answers>", "- cost: $<cost> over <runs − unpriced> priced runs (<unpriced> unpriced)", "- by format: V2 <runs> runs, <written>/<cards> written, $<cost>; mrph <the same of mrph>", "- models: " + each "<model> (<n> run|runs)" ", "-joined; then, when any skipped, "- skipped: " + each "<dir> (<reason>)" "; "-joined. Then always the debt rows (chronology lines whose phase matches /\bdebt\b/i): none → "- debt rows (docs/MEASURE.md): none", else "- debt rows (docs/MEASURE.md), not in these totals: " + each "<phase> $<cost or —>" ", "-joined; and running null → "- running total (docs/MEASURE.md): none", else "- running total (docs/MEASURE.md): \"<running>\" vs $<totals.cost> archived here" + (when running holds a $<number>, the first: ", difference <number − totals.cost>") + " — the two differ by runs made outside this repository (in MEASURE, no archive here) and archived runs MEASURE's total leaves out; debt rows are in neither". Every $ amount and the difference toFixed(4). "", "## Chronology (docs/MEASURE.md)", "": no lines → "- no rows"; else "phase · date · builder · models · written/planned · runs · $ · notes" and per line "- <phase> · <date or —> · <builder or —> · <models ", "-joined or —> · <written>/<planned> written (— when written is null) · <runs> run|runs · $<cost or —>", + " · <notes>" when not empty, + " ← switch: " + switches "; "-joined when any. "", "## File ownership (git, Morph-Card trailers)", "": commits 0 → "- git carries 0 Morph commits"; else "- git carries <n> Morph commit|commits: " + each "<model or —> <commits>" ", "-joined, "- <n> path|paths written by cards, most recent first; per path its cards, newest first:", then per path of the first OWNERSHIP_PATHS (30) "- <path> ← " + its first OWNERSHIP_WRITES (3) writes "<card> (<model or —>, run <run or —>)" "; "-joined, + "; … <k> more" when it has more, then "- … <m> more paths" when more. "", "## What is next", "": row null → "- next phase: none open (docs/PLAN.md)", else "- next phase (docs/PLAN.md): <row>"; handoff [] → "- handoff: no \"## State at handoff\" section (docs/AUTONOMY.md)", else "- handoff (docs/AUTONOMY.md):" and "  > <line>" each. "", "## Last decisions (docs/DECISIONS.md)", "": "- <line>" each, or "- none". "", "## Open issues (.morph/issues.json)", "": absent → "- not read: no .morph/issues.json (the primer makes no network call; `gh issue list --state open --json number,title,labels > .morph/issues.json` writes it)"; unreadable → "- not read: .morph/issues.json is not a JSON array"; read with none → "- none open"; else "- #<number> <title>" + " [<labels ", "-joined>]" when any. A text longer than cap (in string length) is cut: its first cap − 60 chars, up to and including their last "\n", then "_… truncated to fit <cap> chars_\n".

- produces: string

## Function Primer Command

`morph primer [--write]`: reads the tree, the archives and the docs, counts the tests by the profile, renders; one Primer Document.

Behaviour: primerCommand(root, write, deps {env, now}) → {code, document}, synchronous. 1. files = git's gitOk(root, ["ls-files", "-z", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard"], deps.env) split on "\0", empty pieces dropped, duplicates dropped (first kept); a failure is git's thrown Error (not a repository: "git ls-files failed (exit 128): …"), not caught. 2. profile = the PROFILES entry claiming the most files by language's profileForPath, the first in PROFILES order on a tie or when none claims a file (typescript). 3. A test file of a profile (isTestFile, exported): hasExtension and its base name (after normalizePath) matching new RegExp(profile.testFilePattern) — test directories alone do not count (tests/helpers.ts is not a test file). countTests(profile, files {path, text}[]) (exported) → {language: profile.id, files: the test files among them, tests: the sum over them of the matches of the profile's call rule}: typescript /(?<![\w.$])(?:test|it)\s*\(/g (test( and it( — test.skip(, it.todo(, x.test( and split( do not match), python /^[ \t]*(?:async[ \t]+)?def[ \t]+test_\w+/gm. The command reads every test file of the listing (UTF-8; an unreadable one is left out) and calls countTests. 4. Archives: each directory under <root>/.morph/runs (none → []), sorted: {dir: its name, report: the text of its report.json or null, answers: the names in its answers/ ending ".answer.txt" (0 without the directory)}; Read Runs. 5. Read Story with the texts of docs/MEASURE.md, docs/PLAN.md, docs/AUTONOMY.md, docs/DECISIONS.md and .morph/issues.json under root (null when not a regular file) and the Read Runs runs. 6. ownership = git's Read Ownership of git's Read Morph Log(root, deps.env); running = runningLine(the MEASURE text) (exported): its first line whose trim starts "Running total", trimmed, cut before its first " (", over 200 chars → 199 + "…"; null without one. 7. generatedAt = new Date(deps.now()).toISOString() (the only clock); markdown = Render Primer({name: path.basename(root), generatedAt, files: the count, tests, runs, story, ownership, running}, 16000). 8. write → <root>/.morph/primer.md = markdown (mkdir -p), written ".morph/primer.md"; else null and nothing written. → {code 0, document {root, generatedAt, files, tests, runs: the totals, skipped: the skipped count, chronology: the line count, next: the next phase, missing, issues: the issues state, ownership: {commits, paths: the paths' count}, running, chars: the markdown's length, written, markdown}}, keys in that order. Nothing else is read or written; no network, no model.

Steps:
- uses: git
- uses: language
- calls: Read Runs
- calls: Read Story
- calls: Render Primer

## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit.
- One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr.
- Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b). primer reads files and spawns git (git's gitOk, the environment a parameter) only in Primer Command, the clock only there through deps.now; Read Runs, Read Story and Render Primer are pure functions of what they are given, no network anywhere (P12a).
- Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~.

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.
- Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread.

Callee Run Git: One synchronous git call with an explicit environment; the only spawner of the Component.
Behaviour: runGit(root, args, env) spawns `git` with args, cwd = root, env = the given env with LC_ALL=C and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 laid over it (nothing of the parent process is inherited), synchronously, stdout and stderr captured as UTF-8 text. Returns Git Result {code: the exit status (null when killed or not started), stdout, stderr}; a spawn failure gives code null and stderr "git could not start: <message>". It never throws. gitOk(root, args, env) runs runGit and returns stdout when code is 0; otherwise it throws Error("git <args[0]> failed (exit <code>): <first line of the trimmed stderr>").

Schema:
{ root, generatedAt, files, tests: { language, files, tests }, runs: totals, skipped, chronology, next: string | null, missing: string[], issues, ownership: { commits, paths }, running: string | null, chars, written: string | null, markdown }

Callee Read Runs: Every archived run of both report forms summarised, with totals over both; nothing read twice, nothing thrown.
Behaviour: readRuns(archives: {dir, report: string | null, answers: number}[]) → Runs Digest. The archives sorted by dir (code-unit order); per archive, the first that applies: report null → skipped {dir, reason "no report.json"}; JSON.parse fails or gives no plain object (null, an array, a scalar) → "report.json is not a JSON object"; a string runId and an array outcomes → the V2 form; a string deck_id and a plain-object outcomes → the mrph form; else "unknown report format". A summary {runId, format "v2"|"mrph", date, processor, models, cards, written, failed, skipped, requests, cost, answers}: V2 — runId; processor = report.processor; models from report.requests (an array) rows; outcomes = report.outcomes; requests = usageTotals.requests, else the requests array's length; cost = usageTotals.cost. mrph — runId = deck_id; processor = backend_label; models from the values of report.usage (an object); outcomes = the values of report.outcomes; requests = usage_totals.requests, else the number of usage values; cost = usage_totals.cost. Every field is read tolerantly: a wrong type is absent (processor "", models [], a cost not a finite number → null, a missing totals object → {}); generations is never read (an int in V2, a list in mrph). models = the distinct string `model` of the object rows, sorted; cards = the outcomes' count; written, failed, skipped = the object outcomes with that status; date = "YYYY-MM-DD" from a runId starting with 8 digits and "-", else ""; answers as given. Totals, every sum from 0 in run order: runs; v2 and mrph each {runs, cards, written, cost: the sum of cost ?? 0}; cards, written, failed, skipped, requests, answers; cost = the sum of the non-null costs; unpriced = runs with cost null; models = [{model, runs}] in order of first appearance over the runs and their sorted models; from, to = the first and last run's date ("" without runs).

Callee Read Story: The phase chronology, what is next, the last decisions and the open issues, from the texts of four docs and an issues file.
Behaviour: readStory(texts {measure, plan, autonomy, decisions, issues: string | null}, runs {runId, models}[]) → Story. A table: a line whose trim starts with "|", the next line's trim made of "|", ":", "-" and spaces with at least one "-", then every following line whose trim starts with "|"; cells = the trimmed line without its first "|" and its last unescaped "|", split on each "|" not preceded by "", each trimmed, "\|" → "|"; bare(cell) = the cell with every "**" removed, trimmed. Chronology: the FIRST table of measure with a header cell bare "фаза"; columns by bare header: phase "фаза", builder "строитель", cards the first starting "карт", cost the first starting "$", runs "прогоны" (a missing column reads ""). Per row: phase = bare; builder = bare, cut before its first " (", trimmed; planned, written = the two integers of ^(\d+)\s*/\s*(\d+) on the trimmed cards cell, else null, null; notes = the cards cell's text after its first "(" up to its last ")" (to the end without one), trimmed, a text over 100 chars → its first 99 + "…", else ""; cost = the first \d+(\.\d+)? of the cost cell, else ""; ids = every \d{8}-\d{6}(-[0-9a-f]{8})? of the runs cell, in order, runs = their count; date = the first id's "YYYY-MM-DD", else ""; models = for each id the first run with that runId, its models in order, distinct. A main row has a phase matching ^P\d+[a-z0-9]*$; switches only on main rows, against the previous main row: "builder <prev> → <this>" when the builders differ, then "model <prev> → <this>" (each ", "-joined) when this row's models are not empty and differ from the last non-empty models of an earlier main row; else []. Next: the LAST table of plan with a header cell bare "фаза"; its first row whose phase (that column, bare) is not done → phase and row = the row's first three cells bare, " · "-joined, over 300 chars → 299 + "…"; none → null, null. p is done when a main chronology phase m equals p, or starts with p and the rest begins with a letter, or p ends with a letter and the rest is digits only (P11b1 does P11b, P12a does P12, P10a does not do P1). handoff: the first autonomy line starting "## State at handoff" → its text after "## " trimmed, then up to 4 non-empty lines (trimmed) of its section (to the next line starting "## "), from the first one holding the word Next, else from the first; each over 200 chars → 199 + "…"; no such line → []. decisions: the last 5 non-empty lines of decisions, trimmed, a leading "- " removed, over 300 chars → 299 + "…". issues: null → {state "absent", items []}; not a JSON array → "unreadable", []; else "read", items = the elements with an integer number and a string title, {number, title, labels: the strings of labels and the string name of its objects (gh issue list --json labels)}, in order. missing = the keys measure, plan, autonomy, decisions whose text is null, in that order.
